summary: Connect dated rental-price benchmarks to first billing, renewal and financing; do not infer project returns from current spot rates.

evidence_separation.reported: CME planned contract terms and revised notice title
evidence_separation.secondary_commentary: FT frames futures as potential price-discovery mechanism
evidence_separation.modeled: USD50M/IT MW with 8%-10% cost of capital scenarios
evidence_separation.inference: Liquidity and project matching would allow a future test of revenue and financing assumptions
evidence_separation.missing: Live quotes/liquidity; dated billing and spending cohorts; actual cash costs; physical utilization; guarantee tests

caveats: Current latency seed: 3 completed projects, 0 usable censored observations; no population inference.
Construction-capital carry is distinct from book depreciation and hardware obsolescence.
CME benchmarks exclude hyperscalers and are not hardware collateral values.
Do not add WACC carry to a DCF that already prices the same cost of capital.
Cash-settled futures are derivatives, not loan securitizations.
